placements.why: The expressions command the complete suppression, deletion, and retroactive denial of spectrograph calibration records, establishing a thematic counter-narrative that repudiates previously established calibration baselines.
placements.title: Disavowing Baseline Calibration Records to Eliminate Unverified Instrument Data
placements.frame: How does the formal disavowal of instrument calibration records prevent reliance on invalid observational baselines?
